name: shopify-theme
description: Shopify theme with Tailwind CSS, Alpine.js, and Flowbite

scripts.dev: concurrently -n tailwind,shopify -c blue,green "npm run dev:tailwind" "npm run dev:shopify"
scripts.deploy: npm run build && shopify theme push
scripts.claude: claude mcp add flowbite -- npx -y flowbite-mcp
